title: Fix Frontend crash in class management (TypeError: r.forEach is not a function) and enable AI Scanner for teachers in Sidebar
assumptions: Route /classes/:classId is implemented by StudentList.tsx (acting as ClassDetail).
schedule_json in ClassItem can be null, empty object, or contain non-array day values which caused times.forEach / times.map to crash.
API responses for students and classes can be null or undefined, requiring Array.isArray guards and fallback empty arrays.
Backend scan endpoints already permit 'teacher' in UPLOAD_ROLES and STAFF_ROLES; updating frontend Sidebar.tsx allows teachers to access the feature as requested.
